No—this is **not about gifts or airdrops**, and it does not mean NEAR projects will stop offering them.

It concerns an automatic payment to **smart-contract owners**, often the developers behind an app:

• **Before:** When someone used a smart contract and paid a network execution fee (“gas”), the contract’s account received a **30% rebate** from that fee.
• **After the upgrade activates:** That rebate becomes **0%**. The contract owner no longer receives that automatic payment; the amount instead stays in the protocol’s fee-burning mechanism.

So this removes a source of income for app developers—not an airdrop entitlement for users. **It does not itself increase users’ gas prices or prohibit future rewards, giveaways, or airdrops.** Those are separate decisions.

One important distinction: **the software has been released, but the change is not yet confirmed active on mainnet.** The release schedules validator voting to begin on November 4 and 6, 2026; activation depends on successful voting.
